experiences.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace & Hanbok Experience
experiences.description: Explore the grand Joseon-era Gyeongbokgung Palace while dressed in a traditional Hanbok rented from nearby shops. Wearing Hanbok grants free palace entry, and you can stroll through historic courtyards, watch the royal guard-changing ceremony, and visit the National Folk Museum inside the palace grounds.

experiences.name: Gwangjang Market Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Dive into Seoul's oldest traditional market and feast on iconic Korean street foods including bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), mayak gimbap (addictive mini rice rolls), tteokbokki, and fresh yukhoe (beef tartare). Interact with local vendors and experience the vibrant, bustling atmosphere of an authentic Korean market.

experiences.name: K-Pop Idol Dance Class
experiences.description: Take a professional K-pop dance lesson at one of Hongdae's popular dance academies such as Def Dance Skool or K-Arts Academy. Learn choreography from trending idol groups, get insider tips from trained instructors, and immerse yourself in the heart of Seoul's youth K-culture scene in the vibrant Hongdae arts district.

experiences.name: Bukchon Hanok Village & Traditional Tea Ceremony
experiences.description: Wander through the beautifully preserved alleyways of Bukchon Hanok Village, home to hundreds of traditional Korean hanok houses. Visit a local tea house for an authentic Korean tea ceremony experience, learning about the philosophy of darye (tea etiquette) while sipping on premium green tea and tasting traditional rice sweets.

experiences.name: Myeongdong Night Food Crawl & K-Beauty Shopping
experiences.description: Spend an evening exploring Myeongdong's legendary street food stalls offering tornado potatoes, lobster grilled cheese, Korean corn dogs, and hotteok (sweet pancakes). After eating, browse the dense concentration of K-beauty flagship stores including Innisfree, Etude House, and Olive Young to pick up cult skincare and makeup products at local prices.
